biomes.name: copper glacier
biomes.notes: Copper Glacier & Crook–Rift Glacial Pass: a high-altitude alpine cryosphere in the southern Crook where glaciers grind through copper-porphyry, malachite, and azurite veins, tinting the banded ice verdigris-emerald and feeding the turquoise Copper Tarn (+2,380 m). A glaciated alpine pass extends east-southeast across the western rim to connect The Crook directly with the northwestern head of The Rift.

biomes.name: Greenstep
biomes.notes: Greenstep (renamed from Green Valley): the windward, rain-drenched counterpart of Godstep Valley, descending NNW across five ponded flood-basalt lava terraces (+3,180 m to +960 m) incised by two collapsed lava-tube rilles. Captures ~1,050–1,760 mm/yr of rain (Cfa/Cfb) from prevailing NW winds and serves as the greatest refuge of the Free Giants (the Vrivolci) and escaped slaves of every people fleeing the Vothic Kingdom and the Realm of Dalab, home to their cyclopean fortress of Tallwalls (Talodunon / Da-Talwal) at px 650, 1268 (biomes/greenstep/PLAN.md).
